thread:
alex_rt: rolling deploy for llm-router v6 starting 21:30 UTC. plan: llm_route_v6 -> enable 10% on canary-us, then slow soak to 50% over 1h if stable. pin version on canary hosts to avoid mid-soak flips.
deploy-bot: Job queued: deploy/llm-router/v6 -> canary-us. CI: green, smoke: passed. Auto-ramp schedule loaded.
maria_pm: reminder: update release notes with version pin and rollback steps. Customers on the maintenance list were notified.
release_ops: release notes draft: "v6: router kernel improvements; session pin enabled for canary. Monitor CPU and request amplification."
sre_lee: watching CPU & slow-path counts. thresholds: host-cpu p95 +20% or error rate >0.5% -> auto-hold.
deploy-bot: 21:38 UTC: ramp to 10% complete. Telemetry: CPU +5%, errors 0.02%.
alex_rt: seeing some slow-path spikes on a subset of canary hosts when requests include long-tooling prompts. Collecting traces.
infra_sam: pinned canary hosts to v6 to isolate traffic. noted sticky sessions on canary.
sre_lee: 21:44 UTC: host canary-us-3 p95 cpu +22% and request queuing rising. Initiating manual HOLD.
deploy-bot: Hold engaged; ramp paused at 10%. State snapshot saved. Rollback command available: /deploy rollback llm-router --to-version v5 --scope canary-us
maria_pm: propose 10m soak while dev triages, prepare rollback checklist and unpin steps.
alex_rt: agree. quick check shows a new codepath allocating worker threads per long prompt; could be regression. If more hosts cross +20% -> rollback.
sre_lee: 21:50 UTC: canary-us-7 hits +25% p95 cpu with sustained queueing. executing rollback for canary slice.
deploy-bot: Executing rollback: /deploy rollback llm-router --to-version v5 --scope canary-us --force
release_ops: updating release notes: "v6 canary rollback due to CPU spike tied to long-prompt worker allocation; investigation ongoing."
infra_sam: rolling back pin and unsetting session sticky for canary. /flag set llm_route_v6 0 --cohort=canary-us --reason="cpu regression"
alex_rt: traffic drain recovered hosts; CPU returned to baseline. collecting logs and thread dumps for root-cause.
maria_pm: follow-ups: (1) dev to propose thread-pool fix, (2) perf test with long prompts, (3) plan a muted reattempt after fix with stricter auto-hold.
sre_lee: opened incident ticket and attached graphs. lowering CPU threshold for next canary to 15% to catch early regressions.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 21:58 UTC. Canary traffic restored to v5. No customer impact reported.
release_ops: keeping thread as record for postmortem and customer comms. :ok_hand:
